display.purpose: Page and article H1s; in-article H3 section markers.

body.purpose: Long-form article prose and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Custody-stamp metadata, nav labels, dated tags.

components.name: Record Card
components.description: Home page featured-article card; also the base for the article page's outer container.
components.html:
Un Cambio Epochal

Bill Gates expone su visión...
components.css: .ds-record { position: relative; background: #f1e9d4; border: 1px solid #cabb98; padding: 32px 32px 24px; } .ds-ribbon-tag { position: absolute; top: -4px; left: 24px; width: 20px; height: 28px; background: #a13328; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 79%, 50% 100%, 0 79%); } .ds-record-title { font-family: Vollkorn, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 28px; color: #211d17; } .ds-record-body { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #6b6252; }

components.name: Custody Stamp
components.description: Small-caps metadata line showing source, author, and translation credit; always renders after the heading it describes.
components.css: .ds-custody { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #6b6252; } .ds-seal { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #a13328; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 404 recovery action; square, ink-bordered, fills red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #211d17; color: #211d17; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #a13328; border-color: #a13328; color: #e8dfc8; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a13328; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Citation Link
components.description: The one link that stays ribbon-red by default, because its function is provenance itself.
components.css: .ds-citation { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #a13328; color: #a13328; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-citation:hover { background: rgba(161,51,40,0.1); color: #7c2620; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Global header nav; ink text, red underline thread on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-nav-link { color: #6b6252; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 0.2s, text-decoration-color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #211d17; text-decoration-color: #a13328; }

narrative.overview: TechNews.sys reads as an archive that shows its receipts, not a dashboard that announces itself. The site replaced its original near-black, neon-accent 'AI dark mode' with a warm archival ledger: buff paper, ink-black text, and exactly one accent, ribbon-red, reserved for the parts of the page that carry documented provenance rather than for ordinary interactive chrome. Every article is treated as a catalogued record, entering with a visible custody stamp instead of a generic category badge, and a small drawn ribbon-bookmark tag marks each record the way a physical bookmark ribbon marks a page.
keyCharacteristics: Archival buff ground, never dark mode.
Ribbon-red is a meaning, not a link color.
No eyebrow labels above headings, anywhere.
One drawn signature mark repeats across every record.

rules.name: The Custody-Only Rule
rules.body: Ribbon-red never appears as an ambient link or navigation color. If an element's only job is 'this is clickable,' it stays ink with an underline; red is reserved for elements whose job is 'this is documented.'

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No label, badge, or kicker ever sits above a heading. Category, source, and reading-time metadata render after the heading it describes, never before.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: A record is a sheet of paper on a desk, not a floating card. Depth comes from a border and a value shift, never a blurred shadow.

dos: Do keep Ribbon Red to provenance marks, citation links, and in-article section titles.
Do put the drawn RibbonTag mark on any new record surface to keep the signature consistent.
Do render a CustodyStamp after every article's heading block once real per-article source data exists.
donts: Don't add a badge, pill, or eyebrow label above any heading.
Don't reintroduce shadows, gradients, or rounded corners.
Don't invent a publish date or a second source for the Bill Gates piece.
